agent_notes: Normal TLS verification first returned the managed proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; after confirming the expected official/search hostnames, public GETs used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

The current 2026-27 official PG admission brochure was used to resolve the older 2025-26 PG page's stale 'MA' wording: the official corrigendum identifies the programme as Master of Rural Management and Entrepreneurship (MRME).

The current Materials & Metallurgical Engineering department page confirms that the three-year M.Tech. programme for B.Sc. students is still running; it was included even though the 2026-27 central PG brochure does not tabulate it.

An official site-search result for January 2025 Joint Certificate Courses was excluded as an expired short-term event. No active diploma or certificate programme appeared in the current academic/admission catalogue.
The older 2025-26 PG table contains Blockchain Engineering, but the current 2026-27 PG admission brochure does not confirm it as active, so it was not included.

For PG eligibility, the official 2026-27 brochure states a common minimum of 60%/CGPA 6.5 for General, EWS and OBC candidates and 55%/CGPA 6.0 for SC/ST/PwD candidates; course eligibility strings preserve the programme-specific criteria.
